       169
       170    <script setup lang="ts">
       171    import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
       172    import { ElMessage, ElMessageBox } from 'element-plus';
       173    import http from '../../api/http';
       174
       175    const list = ref<any[]>([]);
       176    const total = ref(0);
       177    const loading = ref(false);
       178    const regulations = ref<any[]>([]);
       179    const query = reactive<any>({ page: 1, page_size: 20, regulation_id: '', status: '', type: '' });
       180
       181    const genVisible = ref(false);
       182    const genForm = reactive<any>({ regulation_id: '', question_count_single: 20, score_single: 3, question_count_multiple: 5, score_multiple: 8 });
       183    const sumScore = computed(() => {
       184      const s = genForm.question_count_single * genForm.score_single + genForm.question_count_multiple * genForm.score_multiple;
       185      return Math.round(s * 100) / 100;
       186    });
       187
       188    const taskVisible = ref(false);
       189    const taskStatus = ref('');
       190    const taskData = ref<any>(null);
       191    let pollTimer: number | null = null;
       192
       193    const editVisible = ref(false);
       194    const editMode = ref<'view' | 'edit'>('view');
       195    const editForm = reactive<any>({});
       196    const inUseLocked = ref(false);
       197
       198    const manualVisible = ref(false);
       199    const manualForm = reactive<any>({ regulation_id: '', type: 'single', stem: '', options: [0, 1, 2, 3].map(() => ({ text: '' })), answer: [0], analysis: '', score: 3 });
       200
       201    function toggleAnswer(i: number, checked: any) {
       202      const set = new Set<number>(editForm.answer || []);
       203      if (checked) set.add(i);
       204      else set.delete(i);
       205      let arr = Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => a - b);
       206      if (editForm.type === 'single' && arr.length > 1) arr = [i];
       207      editForm.answer = arr;
       208    }
       209
       210    function toggleManualAnswer(i: number, checked: any) {
       211      const set = new Set<number>(manualForm.answer || []);
       212      if (checked) set.add(i);
       213      else set.delete(i);
       214      let arr = Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => a - b);
       215      if (manualForm.type === 'single' && arr.length > 1) arr = [i];
       216      manualForm.answer = arr;
       217    }
       218
       219    async function load() {
       220      loading.value = true;
       221      try {
       222        const d: any = await http.get('/ai/questions', { params: query });
       223        list.value = d.list;
       224        total.value = d.total;
       225      } finally {
       226        loading.value = false;
       227      }
       228    }
       229
       230    async function startGenerate() {
       231      // 后端 DTO 要求 id 为字符串（bigint 序列化口径），下拉绑定的是数字，提交前显式转换
       232      const d: any = await http.post('/ai/generate-questions', { ...genForm, regulation_id: String(genForm.regulation_id) });
       233      genVisible.value = false;
       234      taskStatus.value = d.status || 'running';
       235      taskData.value = null;
       236      taskVisible.value = true;
       237      // 旧任务的 interval 必须先清理：否则旧回调会误清新任务的轮询句柄（闭环自持 id）
       238      if (pollTimer) window.clearInterval(pollTimer);
       239      const timerId = window.setInterval(async () => {
       240        try {
       241          const st: any = await http.get(`/ai/generate-status/${d.task_id}`);
       242          taskStatus.value = st.status;
       243          taskData.value = st;
       244          if (st.status === 'completed' || st.status === 'failed') {
       245            if (pollTimer === timerId) window.clearInterval(timerId);
       246            if (pollTimer === timerId) pollTimer = null;
       247          }
       248        } catch { /* 状态查询失败保留轮询，下一次再试 */ }
       249      }, 3000);
       250      pollTimer = timerId;
       251    }
       252
       253    async function review(row: any, status: 'approved' | 'rejected') {
       254      let reason: string | undefined;
       255      if (status === 'rejected') {
       256        const r = await ElMessageBox.prompt('填写驳回意见（可选）', '驳回题目', { inputPlaceholder: '驳回原因' }).catch(() => null);
       257        if (!r) return;
       258        reason = r.value;
       259      }
       260      await http.put(`/ai/questions/${row.id}/review`, { status, reason });
       261      ElMessage.success(status === 'approved' ? '已通过' : '已驳回');
       262      await load();
       263    }
       264
       265    function openView(row: any) {
       266      editMode.value = 'view';
       267      inUseLocked.value = false;
       268      Object.assign(editForm, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(row)));
       269      editVisible.value = true;
       270    }
       271
       272    async function openEdit(row: any) {
       273      editMode.value = 'edit';
       274      Object.assign(editForm, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(row)));
       275      // 被 in_progress 记录引用的题目后端仅允许改 analysis（40908），前端先行提示
       276      inUseLocked.value = false;
       277      editVisible.value = true;
       278    }
       279
       280    async function saveEdit() {
       281      try {
       282        await http.put(`/ai/questions/${editForm.id}`, {
       283          stem: editForm.stem,
       284          options: editForm.options.map((o: any, i: number) => ({ key: o.key || String.fromCharCode(65 + i), text: o.text })),
       285          answer: editForm.answer,
       286          analysis: editForm.analysis,
       287          score: editForm.score,
       288        });
       289        ElMessage.success('已保存（判分以当前答案为准）');
       290        editVisible.value = false;
       291        await load();
       292      } catch (e: any) {
       293        if (e?.code === 40908) {
       294          inUseLocked.value = true;
       295          ElMessage.error(e.message);
       296        }
       297      }
       298    }
       299
       300    async function regenerate(row: any) {
       301      await ElMessageBox.confirm('将重新调用 AI 生成替换内容，成功后题目回到待审核，失败则原内容不变。继续？', '重新生成', { type: 'info' });
       302      await http.post(`/ai/questions/${row.id}/regenerate`);
       303      ElMessage.success('已重新生成，状态回到待审核');
       304      await load();
       305    }
       306
       307    async function saveManual() {
       308      await http.post('/ai/questions', { ...manualForm, regulation_id: String(manualForm.regulation_id) });
       309      ElMessage.success('已录入（approved，可直接入卷）');
       310      manualVisible.value = false;
       311      await load();
       312    }
       313
       314    onMounted(async () => {
       315      const d: any = await http.get('/regulations', { params: { page_size: 100 } });
       316      regulations.value = d.list;
       317      await load();
       318    });
       319
       320    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
       321      if (pollTimer) window.clearInterval(pollTimer);
       322    });
       323    </script>
         1    <template>
         2      <div v-if="paper" class="page-card">
         3        <div class="toolbar">
         4          <el-button text @click="$router.push('/admin/papers')"><el-icon><ArrowLeft /></el-icon>返回</el-button>
         5          <el-divider direction="vertical" />
         6          <div class="detail-head">
         7            <h2 class="detail-title">{{ paper.title }}</h2>
         8            <el-tag :type="paper.status === 'published' ? 'success' : paper.status === 'draft' ? 'info' : 'warning'" size="small">
         9              {{ ({ draft: '草稿', published: '已发布', archived: '已归档' } as any)[paper.status] }}
        10            </el-tag>
        11            <el-tag :type="sumScore === 100 ? 'success' : 'danger'" size="small">分值合计 {{ sumScore }} / 100</el-tag>
        12          </div>
        13          <div style="flex:1" />
        14          <el-button v-if="paper.status === 'draft'" type="success" :disabled="sumScore !== 100 || sumScore !== persistedSum"
        15            @click="onPublish">发布试卷（SUM=100）</el-button>
        16          <el-button v-if="paper.status === 'published'" type="warning" plain @click="onArchive">归档</el-button>
        17        </div>
        18
        19        <el-alert v-if="paper.status !== 'draft'" type="info" :closable="false" style="margin-bottom:14px"
        20          title="已发布试卷：题目组成与分值锁定；及格线 / 漏选比例 / 限时 / 补考次数仍可调整（按各自生效边界对后续作答生效）" />
        21
        22        <el-card shadow="never" style="margin-bottom:16px">
        23          <template #header>考试策略</template>
        24          <el-form inline label-width="130px">
        25            <el-form-item label="及格线">
        26              <el-input-number v-model="strategy.pass_score" :min="1" :max="100" :disabled="strategyLocked" />
        27            </el-form-item>
        28            <el-form-item label="限时（分钟）">
        29              <el-input-number v-model="strategy.duration_minutes" :min="1" :max="300" :disabled="strategyLocked" />
        30            </el-form-item>
        31            <el-form-item label="最大作答次数">
        32              <el-input-number v-model="strategy.max_attempts" :min="1" :max="10" :disabled="strategyLocked" />
        33            </el-form-item>
        34            <el-form-item label="漏选部分分比例">
        35              <el-input-number v-model="strategy.partial_credit_ratio" :min="0" :max="1" :step="0.1" :disabled="strategyLocked" />
        36            </el-form-item>
        37            <el-form-item>
        38              <el-button type="primary" :disabled="strategyLocked" @click="saveStrategy">保存策略</el-button>
        39            </el-form-item>
        40          </el-form>
        41        </el-card>
        42
        43        <el-card shadow="never" style="margin-bottom:16px">
        44          <template #header>
        45            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center">
        46              <span>题目组成（{{ paper.questions?.length || 0 }} 题，{{ sumScore }} 分）</span>
        47              <el-button v-if="paper.status === 'draft'" type="primary" @click="pickVisible = true">选题入卷</el-button>
        48            </div>
        49          </template>
        50          <el-table :data="paper.questions || []">
        51            <el-table-column prop="sort" label="顺序" width="70" />
        52            <el-table-column prop="stem" label="题干" min-width="280" show-overflow-tooltip />
        53            <el-table-column label="题型" width="80">
        54              <template #default="{ row }">{{ row.type === 'single' ? '单选' : '多选' }}</template>
        55            </el-table-column>
        56            <el-table-column label="分值" width="180">
        57              <template #default="{ row }">
        58                <el-input-number v-model="row.score" :min="0.5" :max="100" :step="0.5" size="small"
        59                  :disabled="paper.status !== 'draft'" @change="dirty = true" />
        60              </template>
        61            </el-table-column>
        62            <el-table-column label="操作" width="90" fixed="right">
        63              <template #default="{ row }">
        64                <el-button v-if="paper.status === 'draft'" text size="small" type="danger" @click="removeOne(row)">移除</el-button>
        65              </template>
        66            </el-table-column>
        67          </el-table>
        68          <el-button v-if="paper.status === 'draft' && (dirty || sumScore !== persistedSum)" type="primary" style="margin-top:14px"
        69            @click="saveQuestions">保存题目组成</el-button>
        70        </el-card>
        71
        72        <el-dialog v-model="pickVisible" title="选题入卷（仅已通过审核的题目）" width="760px">
        73          <el-table ref="pickTableRef" :data="candidates" @selection-change="(rows: any[]) => (picked = rows)">
        74            <el-table-column type="selection" width="50" />
        75            <el-table-column prop="id" label="ID" width="70" />
        76            <el-table-column prop="stem" label="题干" min-width="280" show-overflow-tooltip />
        77            <el-table-column label="题型" width="80">
        78              <template #default="{ row }">{{ row.type === 'single' ? '单选' : '多选' }}</template>
        79            </el-table-column>

        10    /**
        11     * 组卷服务（05 册 4.4.7）：试卷策略配置、选题入卷校验（approved + 同制度 + 不重复）、
        12     * 发布校验 SUM(paper_question.score) = 100（C-04）、发布后 paper_question 锁定（40907）、
        13     * 策略字段发布后仍可调（pass_score / partial_credit_ratio 判分实时读；duration/max_attempts 对后续发起生效）。
        14     */
        15    @Injectable()
        16    export class PaperService {
        17      constructor(
        18        @InjectRepository(ExamPaper) private readonly paperRepo: Repository<ExamPaper>,
        19        @InjectRepository(PaperQuestion) private readonly pqRepo: Repository<PaperQuestion>,
        20        @InjectRepository(Question) private readonly questionRepo: Repository<Question>,
        21        private readonly audit: AuditService,
        22        private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
        23      ) {}
        24
        25      paperView(p: ExamPaper) {
        26        return {
        27          id: Number(p.id),
        28          regulation_id: Number(p.regulationId),
        29          title: p.title,
        30          total_score: Number(p.totalScore),
        31          pass_score: Number(p.passScore),
        32          duration_minutes: p.durationMinutes,
        33          max_attempts: p.maxAttempts,
        34          partial_credit_ratio: Number(p.partialCreditRatio),
        35          status: p.status,
        36          created_at: p.createdAt,
        37          updated_at: p.updatedAt,
        38        };
        39      }
        40
        41      async list(query: { page?: number; page_size?: number; regulation_id?: number; status?: string }) {
        42        const page = Math.max(1, Number(query.page || 1));
        43        const pageSize = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number(query.page_size || 20)));
        44        const qb = this.paperRepo.createQueryBuilder('p');
        45        if (query.regulation_id) qb.andWhere('p.regulation_id = :rid', { rid: String(query.regulation_id) });
        46        if (query.status) qb.andWhere('p.status = :status', { status: query.status });
        47        qb.orderBy('p.id', 'DESC');
        48        const total = await qb.getCount();
        49        const rows = await qb.skip((page - 1) * pageSize).take(pageSize).getMany();
        50        return { list: rows.map((p) => this.paperView(p)), total, page, page_size: pageSize };
        51      }
        52
        53      async detail(id: string) {
        54        const p = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
        55        if (!p) throw Errors.notFound('试卷不存在');
        56        const questions = await this.pqRepo.find({ where: { paperId: id }, order: { sort: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' } });
        57        const qIds = questions.map((pq) => pq.questionId);
        58        const qRows = qIds.length ? await this.questionRepo.find({ where: { id: In(qIds) } }) : [];
        59        const qMap = new Map(qRows.map((q) => [q.id, q]));
        60        return {
        61          ...this.paperView(p),
        62          sum_score: questions.reduce((a, pq) => a + Number(pq.score), 0),
        63          questions: questions.map((pq) => {
        64            const q = qMap.get(pq.questionId);
        65            return {
        66              paper_question_id: Number(pq.id),
        67              question_id: Number(pq.questionId),
        68              sort: pq.sort,
        69              score: Number(pq.score),
        70              type: q?.type,
        71              stem: q?.stem,
        72              status: q?.status,
        73              source: q?.source,
        74            };
        75          }),
        76        };
        77      }

        79      async create(input: { regulation_id: string; title: string; pass_score?: number; duration_minutes?: number; max_attempts?: number; partial_credit_ratio?: number }, actor: { id: number; name: string }, ip: string | null) {
        80        this.validateStrategy({
        81          pass_score: input.pass_score,
        82          duration_minutes: input.duration_minutes,
        83          max_attempts: input.max_attempts,
        84          partial_credit_ratio: input.partial_credit_ratio,
        85        });
        86        const p = await this.paperRepo.save(
        87          this.paperRepo.create({
        88            regulationId: input.regulation_id,
        89            title: input.title,
        90            passScore: String(input.pass_score ?? 60),
        91            durationMinutes: input.duration_minutes ?? 30,
        92            maxAttempts: input.max_attempts ?? 3,
        93            partialCreditRatio: String(input.partial_credit_ratio ?? 0.5),
        94            status: PaperStatus.DRAFT,
        95            createdBy: String(actor.id),
        96          }),
        97        );
        98        this.audit.log({
        99          actor_id: actor.id, actor_name: actor.name, action: 'paper.create', object_type: 'exam_paper',
       100          object_id: p.id, detail: { title: input.title, regulation_id: Number(input.regulation_id) }, result: 'success', source_ip: ip,
       101        });
       102        return this.paperView(p);

       105      private validateStrategy(patch: { pass_score?: number; duration_minutes?: number; max_attempts?: number; partial_credit_ratio?: number }) {
       106        if (patch.pass_score !== undefined && !(patch.pass_score > 0 && patch.pass_score <= 100)) {
       107          throw Errors.param('pass_score 取值范围 (0, 100]');
       108        }
       109        if (patch.duration_minutes !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(patch.duration_minutes) || patch.duration_minutes < 1)) {
       110          throw Errors.param('duration_minutes 须为 ≥ 1 的整数');
       111        }
       112        if (patch.max_attempts !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(patch.max_attempts) || patch.max_attempts < 1)) {
       113          throw Errors.param('max_attempts 须为 ≥ 1 的整数');
       114        }
       115        if (patch.partial_credit_ratio !== undefined && !(patch.partial_credit_ratio >= 0 && patch.partial_credit_ratio <= 1)) {

       139      /** 组卷（PUT /ai/papers/{id}/questions）：全量替换题目组成；发布后锁定（40907） */
       140      async setQuestions(id: string, items: { question_id: number | string; score?: number }[], actor: { id: number; name: string }, ip: string | null) {
       141        const p = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
       142        if (!p) throw Errors.notFound('试卷不存在');
       143        if (p.status !== PaperStatus.DRAFT) throw Errors.paperQuestionsLocked();
       144        if (!Array.isArray(items) || !items.length) throw Errors.param('试卷至少需要 1 道题');
       145
       146        const qIds = Array.from(new Set(items.map((it) => String(it.question_id))));
       147        const qRows = await this.questionRepo.find({ where: { id: In(qIds) } });
       148        const qMap = new Map(qRows.map((q) => [q.id, q]));
       149        const entities: PaperQuestion[] = [];
       150        const seen = new Set<string>();
       151        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
       152          const it = items[i];
       153          const q = qMap.get(String(it.question_id));
       154          if (!q) throw Errors.param(`题目 ${it.question_id} 不存在`);
       155          // 选题入卷校验（05 册 4.4.7）：approved + 同制度 + 同卷不重复
       156          if (q.status !== QuestionStatus.APPROVED) throw Errors.param(`题目 ${it.question_id} 未审核通过，不能入卷`);
       157          if (q.regulationId !== p.regulationId) throw Errors.param(`题目 ${it.question_id} 与试卷不属于同一制度`);
       158          if (seen.has(q.id)) throw Errors.param(`题目 ${it.question_id} 重复`);
       159          seen.add(q.id);
       160          entities.push(
       161            this.pqRepo.create({
       162              paperId: id,
       163              questionId: q.id,
       164              sort: i,
       165              score: String(it.score ?? Number(q.score)),
       166            }),
       167          );
       168        }
       169        await this.dataSource.transaction(async (m) => {
       170          const repo = m.getRepository(PaperQuestion);
       171          await repo.delete({ paperId: id });
       172          await repo.save(entities);
       173        });
       174        this.audit.log({
       175          actor_id: actor.id, actor_name: actor.name, action: 'paper.questions.set', object_type: 'exam_paper',
       176          object_id: id, detail: { count: entities.length }, result: 'success', source_ip: ip,
       177        });
       178        return this.detail(id);
       179      }

       181      /** 发布（FR-AIQ-07 验收①）：SUM(score) = 100 校验，不足/超出均拦截并提示差额 */
       182      async publish(id: string, actor: { id: number; name: string }, ip: string | null) {
       183        const p = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
       184        if (!p) throw Errors.notFound('试卷不存在');
       185        if (p.status === PaperStatus.PUBLISHED) return this.paperView(p);
       186        if (p.status === PaperStatus.ARCHIVED) throw Errors.param('已归档试卷不可发布');
       187        const sumQb = await this.pqRepo
       188          .createQueryBuilder('pq')
       189          .select('COALESCE(SUM(pq.score), 0)', 'sum')
       190          .where('pq.paper_id = :pid', { pid: id })
       191          .getRawOne();
       192        const sum = Number(sumQb?.sum || 0);
       193        const total = Number(p.totalScore);
       194        if (sum !== total) {
       195          throw Errors.publishCheckFailed(`试卷总分校验未通过：题目分值合计 ${sum.toFixed(2)}，应为 ${total.toFixed(2)}（差额 ${(total - sum).toFixed(2)}）`);
       196        }
       197        p.status = PaperStatus.PUBLISHED;
       198        await this.paperRepo.save(p);
       199        this.audit.log({
       200          actor_id: actor.id, actor_name: actor.name, action: 'paper.publish', object_type: 'exam_paper',
       201          object_id: id, detail: { sum_score: sum }, result: 'success', source_ip: ip,
       202        });
       203        return this.paperView(p);
       204      }

       165      /** 乱序试卷视图（下发不含 answer / analysis，06 册 4.1） */
       166      private async buildPaperView(record: ExamRecord, paper: ExamPaper) {
       167        const pqs = await this.pqRepo.find({ where: { paperId: paper.id }, order: { sort: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' } });
       168        const qIds = pqs.map((pq) => pq.questionId);
       169        const questions = qIds.length ? await this.questionRepo.find({ where: { id: In(qIds) } }) : [];
       170        const qMap = new Map(questions.map((q) => [q.id, q]));
       171        const seed = this.shuffle.deriveSeed(record.id);
       172        const ordered = this.shuffle.shuffleQuestionOrder(pqs, seed);
       173        return ordered.map((pq) => {
       174          const q = qMap.get(pq.questionId)!;
       175          const options = this.shuffle.shuffleOptions(q.options || [], seed, pq.questionId);
       176          return {
       177            question_id: Number(pq.questionId),
       178            type: q.type,
       179            stem: q.stem,
       180            options,
       181            score: Number(pq.score),
       182          };
       183        });
       184      }

       192      async start(paperId: string, userId: number) {

       196        const paper = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id: paperId } });

       199        const regulation = await this.regRepo.findOne({ where: { id: paper.regulationId } });
       200        if (!regulation || regulation.status !== RegulationStatus.PUBLISHED) {
       201          throw Errors.contentInvisible('制度未发布或已归档');
       202        }
       203        if (!isAdmin && !(await this.scopeService.isUserInScope(regulation.id, { id: userId, role: user.role, departmentId: user.departmentId }))) {
       204          throw Errors.contentInvisible('不在该制度的发布范围内');
       205        }

       207        if (paper.status !== PaperStatus.PUBLISHED) throw Errors.contentInvisible('暂未开考');
       208

       210        const learning = await this.learningRepo.findOne({ where: { userId: String(userId), regulationId: regulation.id } });
       211        if (!learning || learning.isValid !== 1) {
       212          const coverage = learning ? ScrollCoverageUtil.normalize(learning.scrollCoverage, regulation.scrollSegments) : ScrollCoverageUtil.empty(regulation.scrollSegments);
       213          const totalSeconds = learning?.totalSeconds ?? 0;
       214          const requiredSeconds = regulation.requiredMinutes * 60;
       215          throw Errors.notEligible('未完成有效学习，暂无考试资格', {
       216            gap: {
       217              time_gap_seconds: Math.max(0, requiredSeconds - totalSeconds),
       218              bottom_segment_covered: ScrollCoverageUtil.bottomCovered(coverage),
       219            },
       220          });
       221        }
       222        // ④ attempt_no ≤ max_attempts 且前次终态 ≠ passed（补考语义：failed/timeout 方可再考，防刷分）
       223        const existing = await this.recordRepo.find({ where: { paperId: paper.id, userId: String(userId) } });
       224        const attemptNo = existing.length + 1;
       225        if (attemptNo > paper.maxAttempts) throw Errors.attemptsExhausted();
       226        if (existing.some((r) => r.status === ExamStatus.PASSED)) throw Errors.alreadyPassed();
       227
       228        // ⑤ 无并发 in_progress（库查优先：已有进行中记录直接返回该记录，断网重进场景 04 册 1.5）
       229        const inProgress = existing.find((r) => r.status === ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
       230        if (inProgress) {
       231          if (new Date(inProgress.deadlineAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) {
       232            // 已超时的 in_progress：交给超时任务处理，此处提示稍后重试
       233            throw Errors.examInProgress('存在进行中的考试，系统正在自动交卷，请稍后刷新');
       234          }
       235          return this.startResponse(inProgress, paper);
       236        }
       237        const locked = await this.redis.setNx(`exam:lock:start:${userId}:${paper.id}`, '1', START_LOCK_TTL);
       238        if (!locked) throw Errors.examInProgress();
       239
       240        try {
       241          // 敏感操作实时回查在职状态（07 册 2.1.4 降级路径 / 04 册 1.3）
       242          const fresh = await this.userRepo.findOne({ where: { id: String(userId) } });
       243          if (!fresh || fresh.status !== 1) throw Errors.accountDisabled();
       244
       245          const now = new Date();
       246          const deadline = new Date(now.getTime() + paper.durationMinutes * 60 * 1000);
       247          let record: ExamRecord;
       248          try {
       249            record = await this.dataSource.transaction(async (m) => {
       250              const repo = m.getRepository(ExamRecord);
       250              const repo = m.getRepository(ExamRecord);
       251              // uk_paper_user_attempt 兜底并发开考：existing/attempt_no 在锁外读取，锁外快照可能过期（撞键时下方兜底）
       252              const entity = repo.create({
       253                paperId: paper.id,
       254                regulationId: paper.regulationId, // regulation_id 冗余快照（03 册 3.4.4）
       255                userId: String(userId),
       256                attemptNo,
       257                status: ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
       258                startedAt: now,
       259                deadlineAt: deadline, // 截止时刻快照，此后不变（防限时调整误判在考记录）
       260                switchCount: 0,
       261              });
       262              return repo.save(entity);
       263            });
       264          } catch (e: any) {
       265            if (String(e?.code) !== 'ER_DUP_ENTRY') throw e;
       266            // 撞唯一键 = 他方并发插入已提交：重读最新记录回放「断网重进」幂等路径（04 册 1.5）
       267            const latest = await this.recordRepo.find({ where: { paperId: paper.id, userId: String(userId) } });
       268            const inProgressNow = latest.find((r) => r.status === ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
       269            if (inProgressNow && new Date(inProgressNow.deadlineAt).getTime() > Date.now()) {
       270              return this.startResponse(inProgressNow, paper);
       271            }
       272            throw Errors.examInProgress();
       273          }
       274
       275          // Redis 计时键：值与 TTL 均由 deadline_at 派生（AD-04 / 03 册 3.4.4）
       276          const ttlSeconds = Math.max(1, Math.floor((deadline.getTime() - now.getTime()) / 1000));
       277          await this.redis.set(this.deadlineKey(record.id), String(deadline.getTime()), ttlSeconds + 60);
       278          await this.redis.set(this.switchKey(record.id), '0', ttlSeconds + 24 * 3600);
       279
       280          this.audit.log({
       281            actor_id: userId, actor_name: user.username, action: 'exam.start', object_type: 'exam_record',
       282            object_id: record.id, detail: { paper_id: Number(paper.id), attempt_no: attemptNo }, result: 'success', source_ip: null,
       283          });
       284          return await this.startResponse(record, paper);
       285        } finally {
       286          await this.redis.del(`exam:lock:start:${userId}:${paper.id}`);
       287        }
       288      }
       289
       290      private async startResponse(record: ExamRecord, paper: ExamPaper) {
       291        const questions = await this.buildPaperView(record, paper);
       292        return {
       293          exam_record_id: Number(record.id),
       294          attempt_no: record.attemptNo,
       295          status: record.status,
       296          paper: {
       297            id: Number(paper.id),
       298            title: paper.title,
       299            total_score: Number(paper.totalScore),
       300            pass_score: Number(paper.passScore),
       301            duration_minutes: paper.durationMinutes,
       302          },
       303          remaining_seconds: await this.remainingSeconds(record),
       304          deadline_at: record.deadlineAt,
       305          questions,
       306          saved_answers: await this.loadSavedAnswers(record.id),
       307        };
       308      }
       309
       310      /** 恢复考试（GET /exams/records/{id}）：同 seed 复现乱序映射 + Redis 暂存恢复（UC-06 A2） */
       311      async recover(recordId: string, userId: number) {
       312        const record = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       313        if (!record) throw Errors.notFound('考试记录不存在');
       314        if (Number(record.userId) !== userId) throw Errors.dataForbidden();
       315        const paper = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id: record.paperId } });
       316        if (!paper) throw Errors.notFound('试卷不存在');
       317        if (record.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
       318          // 已终态：返回成绩摘要，前端路由至结果页
       319          return {
       320            exam_record_id: Number(record.id),
       321            status: record.status,
       322            score: record.score === null ? null : Number(record.score),
       323            finished: true,
       324          };
       325        }
       326        return this.startResponse(record, paper);
       327      }
       328
       329      private async loadSavedAnswers(recordId: string): Promise<Record<string, number[]>> {
       330        const raw = await this.redis.hgetall(this.answerKey(recordId));
       331        const out: Record<string, number[]> = {};
       332        for (const [qid, val] of Object.entries(raw || {})) {
       333          try {
       334            const arr = JSON.parse(val);
       335            if (Array.isArray(arr)) out[qid] = arr.map(Number);
       336          } catch { /* 暂存损坏按未答处理 */ }
       337        }
       338        return out;
       339      }
       340
       341      // ================= 作答 / 切屏 =================
       342
       343      /** 考试心跳（POST /exams/records/{id}/heartbeat）：作答暂存 + 服务端时间校准（05 册 6.4.3） */
       344      async heartbeat(recordId: string, userId: number, answers: { question_id: number | string; selected?: number[] }[]) {
       345        const record = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       346        if (!record) throw Errors.notFound('考试记录不存在');
       347        if (Number(record.userId) !== userId) throw Errors.dataForbidden();
       348        const now = Date.now();
       349        if (record.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
       350          throw Errors.submitConflict('考试已结束');
       351        }
       352        if (new Date(record.deadlineAt).getTime() <= now) {
       353          // 已超时：立即触发自动交卷
       354          await this.autoSubmit(record);
       355          throw Errors.submitConflict('考试已超时，系统已自动交卷');
       356        }
       357        // 5 秒去抖窗口：仅拦截异常高频风暴（作答暂存为幂等覆盖写，重复到达无副作用）；
       358        // 30 秒正常节拍由前端定时器保证，学习心跳同理以远小于节拍的窗口判定「异常高频」（04 册 6.2）
       359        const lastBeat = await this.redis.get(`exam:beat:${recordId}`);
       360        if (lastBeat && now - Number(lastBeat) < 5_000) {
       361          throw Errors.tooManyRequests();
       362        }
       363        await this.redis.set(`exam:beat:${recordId}`, String(now), 300);
       364        // 作答暂存（呈现位置，交卷时服务端还原；每题覆盖写幂等）
       365        for (const a of answers || []) {
       366          await this.redis.hset(this.answerKey(recordId), String(a.question_id), JSON.stringify((a.selected || []).map(Number)));
       367        }
       368        const deadline = new Date(record.deadlineAt).getTime();
       369        return {
       370          server_time: new Date().toISOString(),
       371          remaining_seconds: Math.max(0, Math.floor((deadline - now) / 1000)),
       372          deadline_at: record.deadlineAt,
       373        };
       374      }
       375
       376      /** 切屏上报（POST /exams/records/{id}/switch）：Redis INCR + 1 秒窗口去抖（05 册 6.4.4） */
       377      async reportSwitch(recordId: string, userId: number) {
       378        const record = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       379        if (!record) throw Errors.notFound('考试记录不存在');
       380        if (Number(record.userId) !== userId) throw Errors.dataForbidden();
       381        if (record.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
       382          const switchCount = record.switchCount;
       383          return { switch_count: switchCount, warning: switchCount > SWITCH_WARN_THRESHOLD, risk_flag: switchCount >= SWITCH_RISK_THRESHOLD };
       384        }
       385        // 1 秒窗口去抖：窗口内的重复上报合并计 1 次（防事件风暴与伪造 flooding）
       386        const debounced = await this.redis.setNx(`exam:switch:deb:${recordId}`, '1', SWITCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS);
       387        if (!debounced) {
       388          const current = Number((await this.redis.get(this.switchKey(recordId))) || record.switchCount || 0);
       389          return { switch_count: current, warning: current > SWITCH_WARN_THRESHOLD, risk_flag: current >= SWITCH_RISK_THRESHOLD };
       390        }
       391        const count = await this.redis.incr(this.switchKey(recordId), 24 * 3600);
       392        const warning = count > SWITCH_WARN_THRESHOLD;
       393        const riskFlag = count >= SWITCH_RISK_THRESHOLD;
       394        if (riskFlag) {
       395          // ≥5 风控标记 + 审计日志（人工复核，不强制交卷，07 册 3.2.2）
       396          this.audit.log({
       397            actor_id: userId, actor_name: '', action: 'exam.switch.risk', object_type: 'exam_record',
       398            object_id: recordId, detail: { switch_count: count }, result: 'success', source_ip: null,
       399          });
       400        }
       401        return { switch_count: count, warning, risk_flag: riskFlag };
       402      }
       403
       404      // ================= 交卷与评分 =================
       405
       406      /** 交卷（POST /exams/records/{id}/submit）：三层幂等（防重锁 → 状态机单向 → 乐观锁） */
       407      async submit(recordId: string, userId: number, answers: { question_id: number | string; selected?: number[] }[]) {
       408        const record = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       409        if (!record) throw Errors.notFound('考试记录不存在');
       410        if (Number(record.userId) !== userId) throw Errors.dataForbidden();
       411
       412        // 幂等：终态记录重复交卷直接返回首次评分结果（04 册 1.5）
       413        if (record.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
       414          return this.submitResultView(record);
       415        }
       416        const now = Date.now();
       417        const isTimeout = new Date(record.deadlineAt).getTime() <= now;
       418
       419        // Redis 防重锁：并发重复交卷仅首个请求进入判分
       420        const locked = await this.redis.setNx(`exam:lock:submit:${recordId}`, '1', SUBMIT_LOCK_TTL);
       421        if (!locked) {
       422          const fresh = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       423          if (fresh && fresh.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS) return this.submitResultView(fresh);
       424          throw Errors.tooManyRequests('正在交卷，请勿重复提交');
       425        }
       426
       427        try {
       428          const user = await this.userRepo.findOne({ where: { id: String(userId) } });
       429          if (!user || user.status !== 1) throw Errors.accountDisabled(); // 敏感操作回查在职状态
       430
       431          // 取最终作答集：Redis 暂存 + 交卷请求增量合并（请求增量覆盖写）
       432          const saved = await this.redis.hgetall(this.answerKey(recordId));
       433          const merged = new Map<string, number[]>();
       434          for (const [qid, val] of Object.entries(saved || {})) {
       435            try {
       436              const arr = JSON.parse(val);
       437              if (Array.isArray(arr)) merged.set(qid, arr.map(Number));
       438            } catch { /* ignore */ }
       439          }
       440          // 超时口径（07 册 3.2.4）：deadline 已过则忽略请求体增量，仅以截止时刻的 Redis 暂存判分（与 autoSubmit 一致）
       441          if (!isTimeout) {
       442            for (const a of answers || []) {
       443              merged.set(String(a.question_id), (a.selected || []).map(Number));
       444            }
       445          }
       446
       447          const result = await this.gradeAndPersist(record, merged, isTimeout ? 'timeout' : 'submitted', user.username);
       448          // 成功清理顺序：提交事务 → DEL 答案暂存 → DEL 防重锁 → DEL deadline / 切屏（07 册 3.2.4）
       449          await this.redis.del(this.answerKey(recordId), `exam:lock:submit:${recordId}`, this.deadlineKey(recordId), this.switchKey(recordId));
       450          return result;
       451        } catch (e: any) {
       452          // 判分事务回滚：DEL 防重锁（考生可立即重试）、保留作答暂存（07 册 3.2.4 失败释放约定）
       453          await this.redis.del(`exam:lock:submit:${recordId}`);
       454          throw e;
       455        }
       456      }
       457
       458      /** 评分落库（05 册 6.4.5 评分落库事务）：乱序还原 → 逐题判分 → 条件 UPDATE + 批量 INSERT 单事务 */
       459      private async gradeAndPersist(
       460        record: ExamRecord,
       461        answers: Map<string, number[]>,
       462        submitStatus: 'submitted' | 'timeout',
       463        actorName: string,
       464      ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
       465        const paper = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id: record.paperId } });
       466        if (!paper) throw Errors.notFound('试卷不存在');
       467        const pqs = await this.pqRepo.find({ where: { paperId: paper.id }, order: { sort: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' } });
       468        const qIds = pqs.map((pq) => pq.questionId);
       469        const questions = qIds.length ? await this.questionRepo.find({ where: { id: In(qIds) } }) : [];
       470        const qMap = new Map(questions.map((q) => [q.id, q]));
       471
       472        // 乱序还原：同 seed 重算映射，呈现位置 → 原始选项下标（判分以原始 answer 语义为准）
       473        const seed = this.shuffle.deriveSeed(record.id);
       474        const restored = new Map<string, number[]>();
       475        for (const pq of pqs) {
       476          const q = qMap.get(pq.questionId);
       477          if (!q) continue;
       478          const display = answers.get(String(pq.questionId)) || answers.get(pq.questionId) || null;
       479          if (!display || !display.length) {
       480            restored.set(pq.questionId, null as any);
       481            continue;
       482          }
       483          const mapping = this.shuffle.optionMapping((q.options || []).length, seed, pq.questionId);
       484          restored.set(pq.questionId, this.shuffle.restoreSelection(display, mapping));
       485        }
       486
       487        const graded = this.grading.grade(restored, paper, pqs, qMap);
       488        const passed = this.grading.isPassed(graded.total, Number(paper.passScore));
       489        const finalStatus = passed ? ExamStatus.PASSED : ExamStatus.FAILED;
       490        const switchCount = Number((await this.redis.get(this.switchKey(record.id))) || 0);
       491        const submittedAt = new Date();
       492
       493        let savedRecord: ExamRecord | null = null;
       494        await this.dataSource.transaction(async (m) => {
       495          const recordRepo = m.getRepository(ExamRecord);
       496          // 状态机单向 + 乐观锁（条件 UPDATE：影响行数 0 = 已被处理）
       497          const upd = await recordRepo
       498            .createQueryBuilder()
       499            .update(ExamRecord)
       500            .set({ status: submitStatus, score: String(graded.total), submittedAt, switchCount })
       501            .where('id = :id AND status = :status', { id: record.id, status: ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS })
       502            .execute();
       503          if (!upd.affected) throw Errors.submitConflict();
       504
       505          // 批量 INSERT exam_answer（append-only，无 UPDATE 路径）
       506          const answerRepo = m.getRepository(ExamAnswer);
       507          const entities = graded.details.map((d) =>
       508            answerRepo.create({
       509              examRecordId: record.id,
       510              questionId: String(d.question_id),
       511              selected: d.selected,
       512              isCorrect: d.is_correct,
       513              gainedScore: String(d.gained_score),
       514            }),
       515          );
       516          if (entities.length) await answerRepo.save(entities);
       517
       518          // 判分后落终态：submitted/timeout → passed/failed（五态状态机，03 册 3.4.4）
       519          await recordRepo.update(record.id, { status: finalStatus });
       520          savedRecord = await recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: record.id } });
       521        });
       522
       523        // 交卷事件按制度失效统计缓存（05 册 7.4.4）：完成率/通过率不滞后于最新交卷
       524        await this.statistics.invalidateRegulationCache(String(record.regulationId));
       525
       526        this.audit.log({
       527          actor_id: Number(record.userId), actor_name: actorName, action: 'exam.submit', object_type: 'exam_record',
       528          object_id: record.id, detail: { status: finalStatus, score: graded.total, timeout: submitStatus === 'timeout' },
       529          result: 'success', source_ip: null,
       530        });
       531        return this.submitResultView(savedRecord || ({ ...record, status: finalStatus, score: String(graded.total), submittedAt, switchCount } as ExamRecord));
       532      }
       533
       534      private async submitResultView(record: ExamRecord) {
       535        const paper = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id: record.paperId } });
       536        // 取最高分口径（C-06）：同一试卷多次作答取最高分
       537        const finished = await this.recordRepo.find({ where: { paperId: record.paperId, userId: record.userId } });
       538        const scores = finished.filter((r) => r.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS && r.score !== null).map((r) => Number(r.score));
       539        const bestScore = scores.length ? Math.max(...scores) : null;
       540        const answers = await this.answerRepo.find({ where: { examRecordId: record.id } });
       541        return {
       542          exam_record_id: Number(record.id),
       543          status: record.status,
       544          score: record.score === null ? null : Number(record.score),
       545          pass_score: paper ? Number(paper.passScore) : null,
       546          switch_count: record.switchCount,
       547          submitted_at: record.submittedAt,
       548          best_score: bestScore,
       549          answer_summary: answers.map((a) => ({
       550            question_id: Number(a.questionId),
       551            is_correct: a.isCorrect === null ? null : a.isCorrect === 1,
       552            gained_score: Number(a.gainedScore),
       553          })),
       554        };
       555      }
       556
       557      /** 成绩与答题明细（GET /exams/records/{id}/result）：解析仅在交卷后下发（04 册 3.7） */
       558      async result(recordId: string, userId: number, userRole: string) {
       559        const record = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       560        if (!record) throw Errors.notFound('考试记录不存在');
       561        const isOwner = Number(record.userId) === userId;
       562        const isAdmin = userRole === 'super_admin' || userRole === 'regulation_admin';
       563        if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) throw Errors.dataForbidden();
       564        // 在考拒绝：成绩明细（含 answer/analysis）仅在交卷后下发，恢复在考走 start 幂等路径（04 册 3.7）
       565        if (record.status === ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
       566          throw Errors.submitConflict('考试进行中，成绩明细交卷后可查');
       567        }
       568        const paper = await this.paperRepo.findOne({ where: { id: record.paperId } });
       569        const pqs = await this.pqRepo.find({ where: { paperId: record.paperId } });
       570        const qRows = await this.questionRepo.find({ where: { id: In(pqs.length ? pqs.map((p) => p.questionId) : ['0']) } });
       571        const qMap = new Map(qRows.map((q) => [q.id, q]));
       572        const answers = await this.answerRepo.find({ where: { examRecordId: record.id } });
       573        const finished = await this.recordRepo.find({ where: { paperId: record.paperId, userId: record.userId } });
       574        const scores = finished.filter((r) => r.status !== ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS && r.score !== null).map((r) => Number(r.score));
       575        return {
       576          exam_record_id: Number(record.id),
       577          paper_id: Number(record.paperId),
       578          attempt_no: record.attemptNo,
       579          status: record.status,
       580          score: record.score === null ? null : Number(record.score),
       581          pass_score: paper ? Number(paper.passScore) : null,
       582          switch_count: record.switchCount,
       583          started_at: record.startedAt,
       584          submitted_at: record.submittedAt,
       585          best_score: scores.length ? Math.max(...scores) : null,
       586          questions: pqs.map((pq) => {
       587            const q = qMap.get(pq.questionId);
       588            const a = answers.find((x) => x.questionId === pq.questionId);
       589            return {
       590              question_id: Number(pq.questionId),
       591              type: q?.type,
       592              stem: q?.stem,
       593              options: q?.options,
       594              score: Number(pq.score),
       595              selected: a ? a.selected : null,
       596              is_correct: a ? (a.isCorrect === null ? null : a.isCorrect === 1) : null,
       597              gained_score: a ? Number(a.gainedScore) : null,
       598              answer: q?.answer,
       599              analysis: q?.analysis,
       600            };
       601          }),
       602        };
       603      }
       604
       605      // ================= 超时自动交卷 =================
       606
       607      /** 超时自动交卷（定时任务主触发，每 30 秒扫描 idx_status_deadline 条件，06 册 4.3） */
       608      async sweepTimeouts() {
       609        const rows = await this.recordRepo.find({
       610          where: { status: ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS, deadlineAt: LessThanOrEqual(new Date()) },
       611          take: 50,
       612          order: { deadlineAt: 'ASC' },
       613        });
       614        for (const record of rows) {
       615          try {
       616            await this.autoSubmit(record);
       617          } catch (e: any) {
       618            this.logger.warn(`超时自动交卷失败 record=${record.id}: ${e?.message}`);
       619          }
       620        }
       621        return rows.length;
       622      }
       623
       624      /** Redis 到期键辅助触发（04 册 3.7 辅通道）：检查指定记录是否到期并交卷 */
       625      async checkAndSubmitIfExpired(recordId: string) {
       626        const record = await this.recordRepo.findOne({ where: { id: recordId } });
       627        if (record && record.status === ExamStatus.IN_PROGRESS && new Date(record.deadlineAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) {
       628          await this.autoSubmit(record);

       648          await this.redis.del(`exam:lock:submit:${record.id}`);

    # Kimi Browser Extension (formerly Kimi WebBridge)
    
    Control the user's real browser (with their login sessions) via a local daemon at `http://127.0.0.1:10086`.
    
    ## Tools
    
    | Tool | Args | Returns | Note |
    |------|------|---------|------|
    | `navigate` | `url`, `newTab`(bool), `group_title` | `{success, url, tabId}` | First call opens a tab — see [Tabs](#tabs-and-the-current-tab). `group_title` sets the group's visible label |
    | `find_tab` | `url`, `active`(bool) | `{success, url, tabId, borrowed}` | Re-select a tab **this session** opened; `active:true` borrows the tab the **user** is viewing — see [Tabs](#tabs-and-the-current-tab) |
    | `snapshot` | — | `{url, title, tree}` with `@e` refs | **Accessibility tree** (text) — use this to read page content and locate elements |
    | `click` | `selector` (@e ref or CSS) | `{success, tag, text}` | Synthetic `el.click()` |
    | `fill` | `selector`, `value` | `{success, tag, mode}` | Works on `<input>`/`<textarea>` AND `[contenteditable]` (ProseMirror/Lexical/Slate). `mode` is `"value"` or `"contenteditable"` |
    | `evaluate` | `code` (supports async/await) | `{type, value}` | |
    | `cdp` | `method`, `params` | raw CDP response | Raw `chrome.debugger` passthrough — what `evaluate` is to JS, `cdp` is to CDP. Low-level escape hatch for cases the tools above don't cover |
    | `screenshot` | `format`(png\|jpeg), `quality`(0-100), optional `selector` (@e/CSS), optional `path` | `{format, path, sizeBytes, mimeType}` | Returns a file path, not base64 — see [Screenshots](#screenshots) |
    | `network` | `cmd`(start\|stop\|list\|detail), `filter`, `requestId` | request/response data | |
    | `upload` | `selector`, `files`(string[]) | `{success, fileCount}` | |
    | `save_as_pdf` | `paper_format`, `landscape`, `scale`, `print_background`, optional `path` | `{path, sizeBytes, mimeType, pageTitle}` | Render current page → PDF, returns a file path — see [Save as PDF](#save-the-current-page-as-pdf) |
    | `list_tabs` | — | `{success, tabs:[{tabId, url, title, active, groupTitle}]}` | Inspect tabs in the current session |
    | `close_tab` | — | `{success, closed: bool}` | Close the current tab in the session |
    | `close_session` | — | `{success, closed: int}` | Close all tabs in the session — `closed` is the count. See [Sessions](#sessions) for when to call |
    
    ### Tabs and the current tab
    
    Single-tab tools (`snapshot`, `click`, `fill`, `screenshot`, `save_as_pdf`) act on the **current tab** — the one you most recently opened with `navigate` or selected with `find_tab`.
    
    - **Opening pages**: use `newTab:true` when pages should coexist (comparing, cross-referencing); omit it to send the current tab to a new URL.
    - **Going back to an earlier tab**: call `find_tab` to make a tab **you opened earlier in this session** the current one again. Pass the tab's **full URL** — take it from `list_tabs` or the earlier `navigate` result. A bare root domain (`kimi.com`) may miss a `www.kimi.com` tab, so prefer the exact URL. By default `find_tab` searches **only this session's own tabs** — it never reaches into the user's other tabs or windows.
    - **Acting on a page the user already has open**: pass `active:true` ("use my open X tab" / "the X page I'm viewing"). It **borrows** the tab the user is currently viewing (returns `borrowed:true`); the borrowed tab is operated in place — it is not pulled into the session's tab group.
    - If `find_tab` errors with "no tab matching … in this session", the page isn't open in this session — `navigate` with `newTab:true` instead.
    
    ```bash
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command \
      -d '{"action":"find_tab","args":{"url":"https://www.kimi.com","active":true},"session":"k26-research"}'
    ```
    
    ### Call Format
    
    Every command carries a top-level `session` naming the current task — see [Sessions](#sessions) below. The examples in later sections omit it only for brevity; in real calls always include it. The command format depends on the user's OS.
    
    **macOS / Linux** — inline JSON is fine:
    
    ```bash
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"action":"navigate","args":{"url":"https://example.com","newTab":true,"group_title":"My task"},"session":"my-task"}'
    ```
    
    If the inline call fails — a shell quoting/syntax error from bash, or an HTTP 400 from the daemon — do **not** retry the same command unchanged. Resend the request as a file body:
    
    1. Write the JSON body to a **uniquely-named** temp file with your own file-write tool — never with shell `echo`/heredoc, which mangles the JSON the same way. Use a fresh name per request (e.g. `/tmp/webbridge-req-<random>.json`).
    2. POST the file:
    
    ```bash
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @/tmp/webbridge-req-<random>.json
    ```
    
    3. Delete the temp file as soon as the request returns.
    
    **Windows (PowerShell / cmd)** — the shell corrupts non-ASCII characters (Chinese etc.) carried inline in command arguments or pipes; they reach the daemon as `?` and the text is unrecoverable. Send **every** request as a file body instead:
    
    1. Write the JSON body to a **uniquely-named** temp file with your own file-write tool — never with shell `echo`/heredoc, which corrupts non-ASCII the same way. Give **every** request its own filename with a random suffix (e.g. `webbridge-req-<random>.json`) so concurrent requests never share a file and overwrite each other.
    2. POST the file with `curl.exe` — always `curl.exe`, never bare `curl`, which Windows PowerShell aliases to `Invoke-WebRequest`:
    
    ```powershell
    curl.exe -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$env:TEMP\webbridge-req-<random>.json"
    ```
    
    3. Delete the temp file as soon as the request returns — don't leave request bodies on disk.
    
    ## Sessions
    
    **One task = one session = one tab group.** A `session` collects every tab the task opens into one tab group, so the user sees a single group for "what the agent is doing right now". Pass it as a **top-level field** of the request body (not inside `args`).
    
    - **Pick one session name at the task's start, put it on every command, and never switch mid-task — even across different sites.** Switching session names per site is the #1 cause of fragmented tab groups.
    - Name it after the **task**, not the site (`camping-research`, `phone-compare`). Use multiple sessions only for genuinely unrelated parallel tasks.
    - `group_title` is the human-readable group label — write it in the user's language, on the **first** `navigate` of the task.
    - When you create the group (the first `navigate` of a task), tell the user once that this task's pages are collected under group «title», and that you'll close them whenever they ask.
    
    ```bash
    # First tab: set session + a human label (in the user's language)
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command \
      -d '{"action":"navigate","args":{"url":"https://www.kimi.com","newTab":true,"group_title":"K2.6 feature research"},"session":"k26-research"}'
    # Another site, same task → same session → joins the same group automatically
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command \
      -d '{"action":"navigate","args":{"url":"https://www.moonshot.cn","newTab":true},"session":"k26-research"}'
    ```
    
    Closing is always user-initiated: call `close_session` only when the user explicitly asks ("close those", "clear the tabs"). It clears the whole group in one call.
    
    ## Screenshots
    
    The daemon writes the image to disk and returns `{format, path, sizeBytes, mimeType}` — never base64, since the model can't read raw image bytes. Take the `.path` and open it with the `Read` tool to actually see it.
    
    ```bash
    # Default: PNG of the visible viewport, daemon picks a temp path
    curl ... -d '{"action":"screenshot","args":{}}'
    # Options (each independent): JPEG quality, element-only via @e/CSS selector, custom output path
    curl ... -d '{"action":"screenshot","args":{"format":"jpeg","quality":60}}'
    curl ... -d '{"action":"screenshot","args":{"selector":"@e123"}}'
    ```
    
    A caller-supplied `path` is honored verbatim (parent dirs created, existing file overwritten) — use a unique name to avoid clobbering. `save_as_pdf` follows the same rule.
    
    ## Prefer snapshot over CSS/JS selectors
    
    `snapshot` returns interactive elements with `@e` refs based on semantic role/name. Use them directly with click/fill — they survive CSS class hash changes that break manually-written selectors.
    
    Fall back to `evaluate` (JS) only when:
    - The target has no `@e` ref in the snapshot
    - You need attributes not in the snapshot (e.g., `href`)
    - You need to dispatch complex event sequences, or scroll
    
    ## Evaluate Tips
    
    - Always use compact `JSON.stringify(data)` — never add `null, 2` formatting. Indentation and newlines can inflate the response several times over, causing truncation during transmission.
    - `evaluate` calls share the page's JS realm — re-declaring the same `const`/`let` across two calls throws `SyntaxError`. Wrap in an IIFE for a fresh scope: `(() => { const x = ...; return x; })()`.
    
    ## Text input — use `fill`
    
    `fill` (selector = CSS or `@e` ref, plus the value) works on `<input>`/`<textarea>` (returns `mode: "value"`) and on `[contenteditable]` rich editors — ProseMirror, TipTap, Lexical, Slate, Quill, etc. (returns `mode: "contenteditable"`), firing the right input events so the page reacts.
    
    `fill` is **clear-and-insert**: existing content is replaced. To append, read the current value via `evaluate`, concatenate, then `fill` with the result.
    
    ## Form submit / special keys
    
    There's no separate "press Enter" tool. To submit a form, click the submit button directly (`click` on the @e ref or selector). To dispatch a key event programmatically (e.g. Escape to close a modal):
    
    ```bash
    {"action":"evaluate","args":{"code":"document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true}))"}}
    ```
    
    ## Save the current page as PDF
    
    `save_as_pdf` renders the current page to PDF and returns the file path. All args optional:
    - `paper_format`: `letter` (default) \| `a4` \| `legal` \| `a3` \| `tabloid`
    - `landscape`: `false` (default)
    - `scale`: `1.0` (default), range `[0.1, 2.0]`
    - `print_background`: `true` (default) — keep background colors
    - `path`: caller-supplied output path; if absent, daemon picks a default under OS temp dir using the page title as the filename
    
    `path` semantics match `screenshot`: written verbatim, parent dirs auto-created, existing files overwritten.
    
    Decoded PDF cap is 100 MB. Above that the daemon refuses; reduce `scale` or split the page.
    
    ## Known limitations
    
    - **Sites that strictly check `event.isTrusted`** (some banking portals, captchas) ignore `click` / `fill` because those fire DOM-level synthetic events (`isTrusted=false`). For these, tell the user the page needs manual interaction. (Trusted input is possible at the protocol level via the `cdp` escape hatch, but treat that as advanced.)
    - **Cross-origin iframes**: `fill`, `click`, `evaluate`, and `snapshot` operate on the top frame. If a target element lives in a same-page iframe from a different origin (e.g. embedded sandbox demos), navigate to the iframe's URL directly instead.
    
    ## If a tool call fails (daemon or extension not ready)
    
    **If a tool call can't reach the daemon (connection refused), start it yourself — don't ask the user. This is safe to run anytime: it no-ops if the daemon is already up.**
    
    **macOS / Linux:**
    
    ```bash
    ~/.kimi-webbridge/bin/kimi-webbridge start
    ```
    
    **Windows (PowerShell):**
    
    ```powershell
    & "$env:USERPROFILE\.kimi-webbridge\bin\kimi-webbridge.exe" start
    ```
    
    Then retry the tool call. If it still fails — or the browser extension won't connect — point the user to the help page instead of deep-troubleshooting:
    
    - English: https://www.kimi.com/en/products/kimi-webbridge
    - 中文: https://www.kimi.com/products/kimi-webbridge
    
    Never run `stop` / `restart` / `uninstall` automatically — those kill a running daemon. See `references/operations.md` for anything deeper.
    
    ## Version mismatches
    
    If a tool returns an error containing **"Please update the Kimi Browser Extension"**, the user's browser extension is older than this skill. Don't try to reconcile versions yourself — just tell the user, in their language, to update the extension and retry:
    
    - English: https://www.kimi.com/en/products/kimi-webbridge
    - 中文: https://www.kimi.com/products/kimi-webbridge

        38      @Column({ type: 'decimal', precision: 5, scale: 2 })
        39      score: string;
        40
        41      /** pending / approved / rejected */
        42      @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 16, default: 'pending' })
        43      status: string;
        44

        47      source: string;

        50      createdBy: string;
        51
